successors.name: Wey (state)
successors.text: Yiyi (夷仪), 'modern day Liaocheng City, Shandong'

ledger.x: c. 1043 BC: King Wu of Zhou grants Xing to Pengshu. 'Sometime between 1046 and 1043 BCE, King Wu of Zhou granted lands around modern day Xingtai City to Pengshu of Xing'; 1043 is the end of the page's range.
662 BC: Qi moves Xing to Yiyi.
662 BC: Xing leaves the Xingtai plain.
635 BC: the state of Xing ends in Wey's conquest.

wars.name: Red Di attack on Xing and Qi's relocation
wars.outcome: 'In 662 BCE, Xing was heavily threatened by the Red Di tribes'; Duke Huan of Qi relocated Xing to Yiyi.

wars.name: Wey conquest of Xing
wars.outcome: Xing wiped out by Wey in 635 BCE.

certainty.note: No Xing boundary is on the page; soft throughout.
